pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Roland SC-55 emulator, by nukeykt.
Supported models: SC-55mk2/SC-155mk2 (v1.01 firmware is confirmed to work) SC-55mk1 (v1.0/v1.21/v2.0 firmwares are confirmed to work) CM-300/SCC-1 (v1.10/v1.20 firmwares are confirmed to work) SCC-1A SC-55st (v1.01) JV-880 (v1.0.0/v1.0.1) SCB-55/RLP-3194 RLP-3237 SC-155
